guides.title: Use Tool Router session files as toolkit inputs
guides.description: Convert session file paths into fresh FileUploadable storage keys before calling toolkit actions.
guides.sourceHeading: Session paths are not `FileUploadable` storage keys

guides.title: Pagination limits are endpoint-specific
guides.description: Use each endpoint's schema and cursor behavior instead of assuming one global page-size limit.

guides.title: Deduplicate trigger webhook deliveries
guides.description: Build idempotent trigger handlers because outbound webhook delivery is at-least-once.

guides.title: Custom connection-data fields are toolkit-specific
guides.description: Read each toolkit's auth metadata instead of assuming every API key uses the same field name.

guides.title: Ahrefs actions must use the API host
guides.description: Ahrefs API v3 requests must use api.ahrefs.com rather than the Ahrefs website host.
guides.sourceHeading: Ahrefs actions must call api.ahrefs.com, not ahrefs.com

guides.title: Use CALENDLY_POST_INVITEE for invitee creation
guides.description: Replace the deprecated Calendly invitee action with CALENDLY_POST_INVITEE.
guides.sourceHeading: Use CALENDLY_POST_INVITEE instead of deprecated CALENDLY_CREATE_EVENT_INVITEE

guides.title: Use Canva autofill jobs for design content
guides.description: Populate a Canva design with an autofill job instead of a blank create-design action.
guides.sourceHeading: Use Canva autofill jobs when content must be populated into a design

guides.title: Granola MCP metadata comes from the upstream server
guides.description: Composio can expose only the tools and schemas declared by Granola's official MCP server.
guides.sourceHeading: Composio mirrors Granola's official MCP server

guides.title: Inspect Odoo JSON-RPC errors inside HTTP 200 responses
guides.description: Check the JSON-RPC envelope because transport success does not guarantee Odoo method success.
guides.sourceHeading: JSON-RPC access errors can arrive inside HTTP 200 responses

guides.title: Strava athlete limits belong to the OAuth app
guides.description: Connected-athlete capacity is attached to the Strava developer application behind the auth config.
guides.sourceHeading: Athlete-limit errors belong to the OAuth application

guides.title: Auth-config list pages return at most 50 items
guides.description: Follow next_cursor when listing auth configs and verify the deployed page-size limit.
guides.sourceHeading: Auth-config list pages return at most 50 items
